item.title: NSF Awards $37.5M to CU Boulder-Led Quantum Research Institute
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – A scientific quest to build more accurate clocks, faster computers and new sensors to detect the faintest signs of disease and disaster is getting a $37.5 million financial boost.
